subject: Mutual plan & access controls for evaluation dataset / prompt pack exchange
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara@qalabs.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor.h@acme-robotics.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: mutual exchange — QA datasets & prompt packs?

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the chat yesterday. Acme's evaluation run is next month and we'd like to formalize a short mutual action plan for exchanging a limited test corpus + a sample prompt pack so your models can be validated against our production-like scenarios. High level ask:

- We provide ~2k anonymized test cases (CSV) + 200 prompt templates.
- Redwood provides ephemeral inference access and a read-only sandbox with non-persistent logs for 30 days.

Key constraints from our side:
- Data cannot be redistributed outside the two orgs; no public posting.
- Files must be deleted from any long-term backups after the 30-day window.

Can you confirm Redwood's standard MAP template and whether you can accept the above constraints? I've attached a manifest for the sample dataset (acme_manifest.csv).

Sara
Sara Li
Partnerships, QA Labs
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@qalabs.com>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor.h@acme-robotics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: mutual exchange — QA datasets & prompt packs?

Hi Sara — great to connect.

We can support the exchange with the following proposal (attached as MAP_v1.pdf):

Summary (proposed):
- Redwood will accept the provided test cases and prompt pack under a time-boxed evaluation MAP.
- Access: ephemeral sandbox project (redwood-eval-acme) with tokenized access; logs retained for 30 days then purged.
- Use restrictions: no external redistribution; evaluation-only; model outputs retained only for debugging during the window unless otherwise agreed.
- Deletion: Redwood will run a verified purge 7 days after the window closes and provide a purge report.

Timeline (proposed):
- 2026-09-20: dataset + prompt pack delivery (SFTP / encrypted link).
- 2026-09-22: onboarding & quick smoke tests.
- 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-22: evaluation window (30 days).
- 2026-10-30: verified purge and handoff summary.

Next steps for us:
1) I'll attach ingestion_instructions.md to highlight file format expectations.
2) If this aligns, please confirm and Victor can sign the MAP (DocuSign link included in the attached PDF).

Couple of notes: we will only ingest anonymized cases, and our infra team will run a quick validation before bringing them into the sandbox. If any PII appears in the sample, we'll quarantine and request remediation.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf, ingestion_instructions.md
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Sara Li <sara@qalabs.com>
Cc: Victor Huang <victor.h@acme-robotics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: mutual exchange — security & retention checklist

Looping in a couple of operational items we need cleared before ingestion: 

Required security items (we can expedite once confirmed):
- SOC 2 status: please confirm current attestation and any subservice orgs.
- Encryption: files must be delivered via SFTP with AES-256 at rest; we will ingest into a KMS-protected bucket.
- Key management: if Acme requires BYOK, we support it — please let us know now.
- Audit logs: for the evaluation project we’ll keep token-level access logs for 30 days; these are included in the purge report.

Technical constraints:
- Max CSV row width/size: ingestion_instructions.md (attached) lists schema — we need the manifest to match.
- Testcases with sequence identifiers: include an anonymized UID column; do not include internal customer identifiers.

Legal note (summary):
- The MAP PDF is a short operational agreement. Legal/terms still require an MPA/Mutual NDA addendum for dataset exchange. We can surface a simple addendum — not blocking, but required for production customers.

I'll standby to review the sample once you drop it. Happy to join a quick call if you want to walk through the checklist.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Reliability & Risk, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara@qalabs.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Victor Huang <victor.h@acme-robotics.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: operational timeline & ingestion window

Thanks — a couple of operational clarifications so the infra team can provision cleanly: 

Proposed ingestion plan (operational):
- Delivery method: encrypted SFTP (details in ingestion_instructions.md). Please upload to /incoming/rdw-acme-2026 by 2026-09-20 23:59 PT.
- Validation window: 2026-09-21 (automated schema & sample check).
- Sandbox access provisioning: we'll create service tokens and invite 2 Acme reviewer emails for the 30-day window.
- Testcase labeling: add columns "scenario_category" and "expected_behavior" — helps automated QA.

Operational SLAs:
- Ingestion validation completes within 24 hours of upload (non-blocking exceptions reported).
- Critical issues (PII found, schema mismatch) will pause ingestion and trigger a remediation request.

Deliverables we need from Acme this week:
1) Signed MAP (DocuSign link).
2) Final manifest (testcases_manifest.csv).
3) Contact emails for sandbox reviewers.

I've created an internal ticket for provisioning: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/browse/RDW-137 (ops). Once provisioning is scheduled we'll share temporary tokens and an SFTP host.

Karthik Iyer
Product Ops — Redwood Dedicated Delivery
Attachments: promptpack_sample.zip, testcases_manifest.csv
From: Victor Huang <victor.h@acme-robotics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Li <sara@qalabs.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: mutual exchange — acceptance & next steps

Monica / team — thanks for the clear plan. Confirming Acme accepts the operational MAP and the constraints as written:

- We will deliver the anonymized testcases and prompt pack to the SFTP path by 2026-09-20 18:00 PT.
- We agree to the 30-day evaluation window and the verified purge 7 days after close.
- Legal will sign the simple dataset addendum via the DocuSign link; expect that back by 2026-09-19.

Quick notes:
- We'll provide two reviewer emails (engineering and product) in a separate note to Karthik.
- If you see any schema discrepancies during validation, please flag immediately and we’ll fix within 48 hours.

Looking forward to the run — happy to join a kickoff call on 2026-09-22 if helpful.

Best,
Victor Huang
Head of Product Integration
Acme Robotics
Attachment: signed_map_stub.pdf (will follow via DocuSign)
